title: Making Automated Capture Safer
description: May 18, 2026. Capture redaction, asynchronous classification, and container hygiene become operating requirements.
body:
2026-05-18. Automation that captures work also has to protect it. I am correcting automatic capture so failed tool calls do not become misleading memory, and redacting secrets before captured text can be retained. Classification is moved to an asynchronous path so that a slower local model does not freeze the work that produced the record. Docker cleanup and an explicit handoff complete the change. The lesson is operational: capture must preserve useful evidence without collecting failed noise or exposing what should never enter memory.

What I will test next

The work will be tested against actual practice and recorded when its result is known.

Historical basis: 2026-05-18 repository milestone, commit 895579c.
